collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IV (61-80, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager scratches their nose before every decision, and a rumor says it is a secret signal.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Before (subject) makes any decision at all, (subject.he/she) scratches (subject.his/her) nose. Big decision, small decision, which fish to cook, which path to take: scratch, then decide. (subject.He/She) has no idea (subject.he/she) does it. Recently, though, a few villagers have noticed, and a rumor is going around that it's a secret signal.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) goes about (subject.his/her) day, scratching (subject.his/her) nose before every choice. Each time, someone nearby looks around meaningfully. By evening a small group has decided the signal means "something interesting is about to happen." Oddly enough, several interesting things do. Nobody tells (subject).

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (friend) asks, very quietly, what the signal means. (subject) has no idea what (subject.he/she) is talking about. They work it out together, and (subject) laughs so hard (subject.he/she) has to sit down. Then, without thinking, (subject.he/she) scratches (subject.his/her) nose to decide whether to get up. (friend) points at it in triumph.
